name: the gauge vacuum: the sea
plain: Computed in this page by the same engine: the B = 0 ground state of the same 4-site chain (one-flavour QCD in one space dimension, x = 4, 216 determinants, exact), the sea the baryon stands in. Its quark density is 1.5 on every site, half filling, summed over colours; the tubes are the computed colour-electric energy on each link (0.94, 0.31, 0.94 in the model's units), drawn as in the baryon's rung. It is an eigenstate and does not move, so nothing here moves. A model's vacuum, not the vacuum: one dimension, no transverse gluons, the gauge field removed by Gauss's law; the spacing (0.42 fm) is set by choice. The gauge vacuum this repository has MEASURED is a different model's: the Schwinger (U(1)) vacuum's magic density, 0.437 bits per site at x = 4, converged in volume to 3.7% (conformance/crystal/GF1_RESULTS.md).

carrier.state: the B = 0 ground state of one-flavour QCD in one space dimension, 4 sites: an eigenstate, so nothing in it moves

views.reads: the rung's marks at the zoom's metres per pixel

budget.quantity: what drawing a tile coarse may move against drawing it fine: the draw allocator's tolerance (Acuity, eps_px). It is not a bound on the picture's faithfulness to the holon.

owed: The engine joins this rung below by a cut, and nothing is declared below it: the rung the cut leads to (the 3+1D gauge field) is not on main.
